--- create_property_graph_quoted_schema.sql
CREATE OR REPLACE PROPERTY GRAPH `order`.`group` NODE TABLES (People)

--- AST
&ast.CreatePropertyGraph{
  OrReplace: true,
  Name:      &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 33,
        NameEnd: 40,
        Name:    "order",
      },
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 41,
        NameEnd: 48,
        Name:    "group",
      },
    },
  },
  Content: &ast.PropertyGraphContent{
    NodeTables: &ast.PropertyGraphNodeTables{
      Node:   49,
      Tables: &ast.PropertyGraphElementList{
        Lparen:   61,
        Rparen:   68,
        Elements: []*ast.PropertyGraphElement{
          &ast.PropertyGraphElement{
            Name: &ast.Ident{
              NamePos: 62,
              NameEnd: 68,
              Name:    "People",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE OR REPLACE PROPERTY GRAPH `order`.`group` NODE TABLES (People)
